methods.confidence_definition: Heuristic diagnostic score, not a calibrated probability.
methods.time_origin: Gapless decoded audio playback beginning, seconds; use HTMLMediaElement.currentTime.
methods.tempo: 24s local autocorrelation context, 6s output segments, 70-260 BPM candidate search. Half/double alternatives retained; weak hardstyle preference only breaks near ties.
methods.beats: Local tempo grid phase fitted to onset envelope in each 6s segment, snapped within 60ms to spectral onsets. No meter/downbeat inference.
methods.onsets: Weighted full-band/bass positive log spectral flux, adaptive mean+0.6 sigma threshold, 110ms peak separation.
methods.energy: 250ms RMS and bass energy windows; mono dBFS-like RMS can exceed 0 dBFS after floating MP3 decode. Relative energy normalized to mix p10-p95.
methods.sections: 4s before/after RMS, bass and centroid context; 8s minimum separation, local onset alignment. Approximate 2s uncertainty. No track labels inferred.
methods.scenes: Creative circuitry/build/reveal mapping from inferred boundaries; visual chapters are not identified songs.
methods.timing_limits: Onset/beat quantization about 10ms with 93ms spectral windows; unverified metrical phase and browser decoder alignment. Gapless tag timing differs from Windows duration by 31.93ms.
